question: Which of the following molecules has at least a 90º angle ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: H2O -> bent molecular geometry -> at least a 90º angle -> 100% CHAIN: NH3 -> pyramidal molecular geometry -> at least a 90º angle -> 100% CHAIN: CH4 -> tetrahedral molecular geometry -> at least a 109.5º angle -> 90% CHAIN: SF4 -> seesaw molecular geometry -> at least a 90º angle -> 100% CHAIN: BF3 -> trigonal planar molecular geometry -> less than a 90º angle -> 100%
analysis: In chemistry, the shape of a molecule is determined by its molecular geometry. A molecule with at least a 90º angle would indicate a bent or trigonal pyramidal shape. Among the given options, NH3 (ammonia) and SF4 (sulfur tetrafluoride) have shapes that include at least a 90º angle.
